stem: How does the playwright develop George Washington's character through the dialogue in lines 37 through 42?

options.label: A
options.text: By revealing that Washington does not believe in keeping secrets from his soldiers

options.label: B
options.text: By demonstrating that Washington considers the opinion of his wife

options.label: C
options.text: By suggesting that Washington is suspicious of anyone unfamiliar to him

options.label: D
options.text: By showing that Washington depends on his wife to identify spies
